title: Too expensive
body: The price is ridiculous for the functionality
author: AnnPuol

title: Atoms - expensive
body:
Loved the Atomic Habits book, the app looks good but annoying that I can’t back date “streak”. For example: I started working out on Monday but found the app on Wednesday, I should be able to add streak on Monday and Tuesday.

Secondly, maybe more important: it is way too expensive - costs more than Disney+/Netflix subscription. This is after getting a newsletter about reduction in price.
author: Review245764
